column1: # Medium/High alerts fail the build unless IGNOREd here WITH a reason.
# Keep this list short and re-review it when the CSP or headers change.

column3: Storable/cacheable content: informational on a static SPA bundle; API responses send private/no-store where it matters
Suspicious comments in the minified bundle: library source comments, no secrets (gitleaks/semgrep cover secrets)
Timestamp disclosure: build hashes / epoch values in JS, not server internals
